Levels.22: start of the movie presentation (same event, alternate raw trigger label without the S-prefix in a small number of recordings)
Levels.23: end of the movie presentation (same event, alternate raw trigger label without the S-prefix in a small number of recordings)
Levels.boundary: recording discontinuity marker inserted by EEGLAB (e.g. the recording was paused/resumed, or segments were concatenated); not a task trigger.
